description: The existing Insights revelations, rewritten as rotating variants. Facts, thresholds and caveats are unchanged.
voice: Clear first, charming second. Every card keeps its caveat: snapshots are snapshots, plans are not meals, unlogged is not missed.

variants.title: {completed} of {planned} planned tasks are done.
variants.body: A snapshot of the tasks planned in this range, as they stand right now. Rescheduling isn’t failure, and these aren’t completion dates.

variants.title: {completed} down, out of {planned} planned.
variants.body: This counts tasks planned for these dates and where they stand today. Plans move; that’s what plans are for.

variants.title: Planned {planned}, done {completed}.
variants.body: Today’s view of everything planned in this range. Anything you moved simply moved.

variants.title: {difference} than last period.
variants.body: {current} tasks finished on recorded dates, against {previous} in the equal-length period before. Completion timestamps only.

variants.title: A busier stretch, {difference}.
variants.body: Comparing equal-length periods by when tasks were actually finished, {current} now and {previous} before.

variants.title: The checklist moved faster.
variants.body: {current} dated completions this period and {previous} the one before. Same length, same rules.

variants.title: {difference} than last period.
variants.body: {current} tasks finished on recorded dates, against {previous} before. Quieter stretches belong to the rhythm too.

variants.title: A gentler pace this period.
variants.body: {current} dated completions now, {previous} in the equal-length period before. Fewer boxes ticked is a count, not a verdict.

variants.title: The list took a breather.
variants.body: Comparing equal stretches by actual completion dates, {current} now and {previous} before.

variants.title: Water goal met on {metDays}.
variants.body: Out of {knownGoals} logged days with a goal. Days without a log aren’t counted as misses.

variants.title: Hydrated on {metDays}.
variants.body: That’s from {knownGoals} days with a goal on record. Unlogged days stay out of it.

variants.title: {met} of {knownGoals} logged days, goal reached.
variants.body: Only days you logged count here, so nothing is assumed about the rest.

variants.title: {plannedDays} had something to look forward to.
variants.body: {plans} meal plans in this range. These are plans, not a record of what was eaten.

variants.title: Meals on the calendar, {plannedDays}.
variants.body: {plans} plans across them. Future you has been well looked after.

variants.title: A little forethought, {plannedDays} of it.
variants.body: {plans} meal plans in this range. Planned, not necessarily eaten, and that’s fine.

variants.title: {feeling} has been part of the picture.
variants.body: Selected in {count} of your {checkins} check-ins. A check-in can hold more than one feeling.

variants.title: {feeling}, often.
variants.body: You named it in {count} of {checkins} check-ins. A count, not a conclusion.

variants.title: A feeling that keeps coming up.
variants.body: {feeling} appears in {count} of {checkins} check-ins. Feelings travel in company, so it is one of several.

variants.title: {category} is your largest recorded spending category.
variants.body: {amount} across {transactions} recorded transactions in this range. Card payments, savings and expected charges aren’t counted as spending.

variants.title: The biggest share went to {category}.
variants.body: {amount} of recorded spending, from {transactions} transactions in this range. Only what you recorded counts.

variants.title: Top of the spending list, {category}.
variants.body: {amount} in this range across {transactions} recorded transactions. Payments, savings and expected charges are left out.
